hero.title: Hello, I am
hero.subtitle: FRONTEND SOFTWARE DEVELOPER
hero.paragraph: With a passion for frontend development, I create user-friendly applications and look forward to working with a motivated team.

section1.subtitle: A Few Words About Me
section1.paragraph1: I am Kenan Ćurevac, a 28-year-old engineer with a Bachelor's degree in Traffic Engineering from the University of Sarajevo, where I currently live. I have a strong affinity for mathematics and analytical thinking and participated in math competitions during my school years, which led me to discover programming as a field that aligns closely with these strengths.
section1.paragraph2: I gained one and a half years of experience in Quality Assurance (QA), primarily writing test documentation, which strengthened my detail-oriented work style and helped solidify my fluent English skills. I am fluent in German as well, having grown up with German television. I am working as an Intern in the Department for Development, which provided a natural extension of my degree to further develop my qualifications and gain practical experience.
section1.paragraph3: I am consistently learning and challenging myself, take great pride in my work, and strive to continuously expand my knowledge rather than let it stagnate. I enjoy applying what I learn in practice and have built several personal projects to further solidify and extend my skills. Feel free to take a look at them — I look forward to hearing from you!

section1.subtitle: Studies
section1.paragraph: I hold a Bachelor's degree in Traffic Engineering from the University of Sarajevo, Bosnia and Herzegovina, with a focus on road traffic.

section2.subtitle: Languages
section2.paragraph: I hold a C1 certificate in German from the Goethe-Institut. In addition, I speak fluent English at a C1 level.

section1.subtitle: QA at Bloola GmbH
section1.paragraph: As a QA at the German company Bloola GmbH, I was responsible for conducting manual tests of a web app. Both communication with international colleagues and test documentation were conducted in English.

section2.subtitle: Position as a Call Agent
section2.paragraph: As a Call Agent in a call center, I was able to significantly develop my skills in communication, empathy, and sales. I was responsible for supporting and advising German customers as well as closing contracts for electricity, gas, internet, and telephone services.

section3.subtitle: Intern in the Municipality of Hadžići
section3.paragraph: As an intern at the Municipality of Hadžići, I supported the Department for Development and Housing-Communal Affairs with office tasks such as document processing, correspondence, and administrative organization. I also worked with Microsoft Word and Excel to create and manage documents and spreadsheets.

section1.paragraph1: Quiz App is an interactive quiz application consisting of 10 questions with four answer options each.
section1.paragraph2: After completing the quiz, users receive an evaluation of their answers, providing immediate feedback on their performance.
section1.paragraph3: Technologies: React, TypeScript, Redux Toolkit, Material UI, The Trivia API

section2.paragraph1: Film Atlas is a film discovery platform that allows users to search for movies, TV series, and people in the film industry, with access to detailed information for each entry.
section2.paragraph2: It features current theatrical releases, popular and top-rated content, upcoming movies with trailers, and an overview of currently airing TV series.
section2.paragraph3: Technologies: React, TypeScript, SCSS, Material UI, The Movie Database API

section3.paragraph1: Pin the Place is a full-stack interactive geography quiz game where users answer ten timed questions and pinpoint locations on a world map.
section3.paragraph2: Each round is limited to 15 seconds, and players earn up to 5 points based on the accuracy of their guess. After the quiz, users receive a detailed results view with distances, points and a summary map displaying all correct answers.
section3.paragraph3: Frontend: Next.js, TypeScript, Zustand, TanStack Query, shadcn/ui, Leaflet
section3.paragraph4: Backend: Express.js, Prisma ORM, PostgreSQL, Zod
